name: M4 four IOL ring
description: Fixed four-node 1024 MB ring for the deterministic M4 RAM state machine.

nodes.name: R1
nodes.startupConfig:
hostname R1
!
interface Ethernet0/0
 ip address 10.0.12.1 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
interface Ethernet0/1
 ip address 10.0.41.2 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
ip route 10.0.34.0 255.255.255.252 10.0.12.2
ip route 10.0.23.0 255.255.255.252 10.0.12.2
end

nodes.name: R2
nodes.startupConfig:
hostname R2
!
interface Ethernet0/0
 ip address 10.0.12.2 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
interface Ethernet0/1
 ip address 10.0.23.1 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
ip route 10.0.34.0 255.255.255.252 10.0.23.2
end

nodes.name: R3
nodes.startupConfig:
hostname R3
!
interface Ethernet0/0
 ip address 10.0.23.2 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
interface Ethernet0/1
 ip address 10.0.34.1 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
ip route 10.0.12.0 255.255.255.252 10.0.23.1
end

nodes.name: R4
nodes.startupConfig:
hostname R4
!
interface Ethernet0/0
 ip address 10.0.34.2 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
interface Ethernet0/1
 ip address 10.0.41.1 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
end
